title: Cashback Apps that Pay via PayPal
metaDescription: Discover the top cashback apps that pay via PayPal and start earning rewards today**
body: ** ** **Cashback Apps that Pay via PayPal: A Comprehensive Guide** Are you tired of using cashback apps that only offer rewards in the form of gift cards or points? Do you prefer the flexibility of PayPal cashback? Look no further. In this article, we'll explore the top cashback apps that pay via PayPal, along with their features, benefits, and earning potential. **What are Cashback Apps?** Cashback apps are online platforms that offer a percentage of your purchase back as a reward. These apps partner with thousands of merchants to provide users with a unique link or code to earn cashback. When you shop through these links or use the codes, the cashback app earns a commission, which is then passed on to you as a reward. **Top Cashback Apps that Pay via PayPal** Here are some of the top cashback apps that pay via PayPal: ### 1. **Ibotta** Ibotta is one of the most popular cashback apps that pay via PayPal. It offers cashback on grocery items, gas, and other purchases from top brands. With Ibotta, you can earn up to 10% cashback on certain items. **How it works:** Browse the Ibotta app for offers, purchase the items, and upload your receipt to earn cashback. Ibotta will match your offer and add it to your account. ### 2. **Rakuten (formerly known as Ebates)** Rakuten is another well-known cashback app that pays via PayPal. It offers cashback on purchases from over 2,500 brands, including Walmart, Home Depot, and Macy's. Rakuten offers up to 40% cashback on certain items. **How it works:** Browse the Rakuten app for offers, click on the merchant's link, and shop as usual. Rakuten will track your purchase and add the cashback to your account. ### 3. **TopCashback** TopCashback is a UK-based cashback app that pays via PayPal. It offers cashback on purchases from over 3,000 merchants, including Amazon, ASOS, and eBay. **How it works:** Browse the TopCashback app for offers, click on the merchant's link, and shop as usual. TopCashback will track your purchase and add the cashback to your account. ### 4. **Dosh** Dosh is a cashback app that pays via PayPal. It offers cashback on purchases from over 100,000 merchants, including restaurants, hotels, and retailers. **How it works:** Link your credit or debit card to the Dosh app, make a purchase, and earn cashback. Dosh will automatically track your purchase and add the cashback to your account. ### 5. **Fetch Rewards** Fetch Rewards is a cashback app that pays via PayPal. It offers cashback on purchases from over 300 brands, including grocery stores and gas stations. **How it works:** Download the Fetch Rewards app, upload your receipt, and earn cashback. Fetch Rewards will match your purchase and add the cashback to your account. **Comparing Cashback Apps** While all the apps mentioned above offer cashback via PayPal, each has its unique features and benefits. Here's a comparison of the top cashback apps: | App | Cashback Rate | Minimum Payout | User Reviews | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Ibotta | Up to 10% | $20 | 4.5/5 | | Rakuten | Up to 40% | $5 | 4.5/5 | | TopCashback | Up to 40% | $1 | 4.5/5 | | Dosh | Up to 10% | $25 | 4.5/5 | | Fetch Rewards | Up to 5% | $25 | 4.5/5 | **Conclusion** Cashback apps that pay via PayPal offer a convenient way to earn rewards on your purchases. With the top apps mentioned above, you can earn up to 40% cashback on certain items. Always read the terms and conditions of each app and understand how the cashback works before signing up. **Get Started with Qmee** Join Qmee Free → Join Qmee Free and start earning cashback on your purchases. Qmee offers a user-friendly interface and a simple way to earn cashback on your everyday purchases. **Additional Tips** 1. **Sign up for multiple cashback apps**: Each app offers unique cashback rates and benefits. Signing up for multiple apps can help you maximize your earnings. 2. **Read the terms and conditions**: Understand how the cashback works, including minimum payout thresholds and cashback rates. 3. **Monitor your account**: Keep track of your earnings and adjust your shopping habits accordingly. 4. **Combine with other rewards programs**: Stack your cashback earnings with other rewards programs, such as credit card points or loyalty programs. By following these tips and utilizing the top cashback apps that pay via PayPal, you can earn significant rewards on your purchases and maximize your savings.
